- Node.js: v25.1.0, npm 11.6.2

Branch coverage measures the share of decision outcomes (each side of every `if`, `?:`, `&&`, `||`, `switch` case) executed by the tests. It is stricter than statement coverage: every line can run while one side of a condition is never tested.

Requirement: CSQP-NF-005, and the backend CI gate in `backend/.c8rc.json` sets `"branches": 70`.
